name: agent-workflows
description: This repository is its own marketplace: it hosts the agent-workflows plugin from the same tree it develops it in, so the placed copy and the tested copy are one thing.

plugins.name: agent-workflows
plugins.description: The layer wrapped around mattpocock/skills, which carries an idea only as far as a commit. Adds the ship tail (ship-create-pr, ship-merge) that takes it to merged, a finish review that runs the project's tooling and clears the leftovers a diff review cannot see, a report contract, and review gates for existing documents. Also ships doc-workflow (doc-*) for READMEs. Run setup-agent-workflows once per project: it writes the .claude/rules/project-profile.md every unit resolves its values from.
